archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Tailored for Deep Navy & Orange brand identity)

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tighter leading-tight text-primary

header.style: Glassmorphism over Hero or Solid White. Sticky header must use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-b border-surface_border. Must contain logo, nav links, and CTA.
header.floating_cta: Floating 'Get Quote' button fixed at top-right or within header sticky area. Background: #FF5A00. Opens a Slide-over (Shadcn Sheet).

cards.style: Flat design. bg-white border border-surface_border rounded-xl hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300. No default heavy shadows.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF5A00] text-white font-medium rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#E65000] transition-colors shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#0B1B3D] border border-[#0B1B3D] font-medium rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#0B1B3D] hover:text-white transition-colors

multi_step_form.style: Clean progressive disclosure. Use Shadcn Tabs or step components. Use bold Orange for active step indicators. Keep form fields clean with Shadcn Input/Select. Never use native dropdowns.

pills_chips.style: For cities (Delhi, Noida, etc) and brands. bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-medium hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-transparent hover:border-slate-300.

images.description: Abstract dark blue textured background for the hero section to contrast with white text and orange CTA.
Close-up of a broken smartphone screen to illustrate the problem.
Technician repairing a phone, representing the doorstep service.

icons.instructions: DO NOT use images for brand logos. MUST use react-icons/si for Simple Icons. Examples: SiApple, SiSamsung, SiOneplus, SiXiaomi, SiGoogle, SiMotorola. Use lucide-react for general UI icons.

features_and_instructions: Build a high-end, corporate, trust-first multi-page structure targeting SEO for City x Brand.
Enquiry Form: Implement a Slide-over (Shadcn Sheet) triggered by a floating 'Get Quote' button on the top right. Form should capture Brand, Model, Issue, Name, Number.
Trust Signals: Include visual badges for '₹ Pricing', 'Genuine Parts', '90-Day Warranty', and 'Doorstep Service'.
Hero Section: Needs a trust strip below it featuring stats or brand logos. The hero should feel editorial and feature the Deep Navy Blue prominently.
Multi-step Booking Flow: A prominent section or dedicated page where users pick Brand -> Model -> Issue -> Schedule.
City Matrix: Display SEO-friendly pill links for Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Mumbai.
Services List: Screen, Battery, Charging Port, Back Glass, Water Damage, Speakers/Mic/Camera, Diagnostics.
Admin Dashboard: Create a protected route using a dense, cardless 'Control Room' grid layout for managing incoming enquiries.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) for testing.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Deep Navy meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use dark indigo/slate for text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Stagger list items in bento grids slightly on scroll.
